about: Official pages for US and Canadian parks POTA lists with no website (HQ worklist, Oct 25 2026: KPC_Park_OfficialPages_done.xlsx). web = the park's own page (filled into data/parkinfo by kpc_state_links.py when POTA has none); agency_page = a general agency list reused for several parks (not the park's own page); map = official map link. NOT FOUND parks are left for later; Canada added Oct 25 from HQ round 10 (KPC_Round10_done.xlsx tab 3).
